description: Authoritative station identity for the ADR-090 production-line measurement model. A station_id here is the identity; every value under aliases is a way some emitter or surface refers to it, never a competing identity. Successor to gc-station-catalogue-v1.json, which stays on disk unmodified as a published version: v2 adds the spotbugs, policy, and vale sub-gates (issue #1355) and never drops or renames a v1 id.

alias_kinds.adr061_phase: A phase string persisted on WorkflowPhaseEvent (ADR-061).
alias_kinds.adr036_stage: A routing stage id from .ground-control.yaml routing.stages and the step-file stage_id frontmatter (ADR-036).
alias_kinds.issue_thread_marker: A value written into a <!-- gc:phase --> marker on the issue thread (ADR-029).
alias_kinds.mcp_action: A gc_implement_mechanical action name that instruments this entry.
alias_kinds.skill_step: A SKILL step number. An ordinal in a document, never an identity.
alias_kinds.display_label: Human-facing wording. Explicitly non-identity: renaming one is never a breaking contract change.

stations.title: Issue and branch resolution
stations.inspects: That the issue, its requirements, and a compliant branch resolve in the invocation checkout.

stations.title: Architecture preflight
stations.inspects: The proposed change against the repository's architecture, producing binding guardrails.

stations.title: Completion gate
stations.inspects: The configured completion command, the configured policy command, and the server-side quality gates. Composite: the spotbugs, policy, and vale child gates run underneath it and report their own verdicts separately, so this station's result is the boundary's own verdict rather than a roll-up of theirs.

stations.title: SpotBugs
stations.inspects: The compiled Java tree for bug patterns, read from the SpotBugs report the completion command already produced.

stations.title: Repo policy
stations.inspects: The diff against the repo-native ADR and workflow guardrails, returning structured Violation codes.

stations.title: Vale
stations.inspects: Changed Markdown against the repository's prose style rules.

stations.title: Codex review
stations.inspects: The pre-push diff for defects, returning structured findings.

stations.title: Test-quality review
stations.inspects: Whether the diff's tests actually prove what they claim to prove.

stations.title: Pre-commit boundary
stations.inspects: The configured pre-commit hook set against the staged tree.

stations.title: Publish
stations.inspects: Stage, pre-commit hooks, commit, push, and remote-base synchronization.

stations.title: Continuous integration
stations.inspects: The repository's CI run for the pushed head commit.

stations.title: SonarCloud
stations.inspects: The SonarCloud quality gate and the repository's new-issue gate.

non_station_stages.reason: Consumes the already-fetched issue thread. Inspects nothing and records no durable transition.
Agent exploration of existing coverage. Produces judgement, not a pass/fail verdict.
The work being inspected, not an inspection of it.
Maps requirement clauses to artifacts. Its verdict surfaces through the completion gate rather than as its own station.
Body shape is enforced inside the render tool at construction time, not observed as a separate gate execution.
